title: Inscape Google Workspace Sites Analytics API Extension
user_story: As a Google Workspace administrator, I want to access comprehensive analytics for Google Sites within the Inscape platform, covering management, adoption, and engagement, so I can effectively monitor site security, track usage trends, and understand user behavior to optimize my organization's use of Google Sites.
acceptance_criteria: Admin SDK Reports Activity API (applicationName=drive) is successfully integrated to extract doc_title, visibility, and internal/external visibility counts for Sites.
A daily ingestion job reliably populates a BigQuery staging table (site_id, data_date) with Sites management events.
A dbt model, rpt_sites_management, is successfully generated, providing structured management data.
The /v1/reports/sites-management API endpoint is implemented, supporting date ranges and filters by visibility and owner.
The /v1/reports/sites-management endpoint accurately returns inventories of external sites, internal-only sites, and per-site sharing posture.
Admin SDK customer usage reports (specifically sites:num_30day_active_users, sites:num_sites_created, sites:num_sites_viewed) are successfully consumed.
A daily ingestion job reliably populates a BigQuery raw table (entity_customer_id, data_date) with usage data.
dbt models generate rpt_sites_usage_trends, with schemas aligned to existing Gmail/Drive usage reports.
The Inscape API accurately surfaces 30-day active site users, sites created per day, and sites viewed per day.
The GA4 Data API integration is available for customers who link a GA4 property to their Sites.
site_id is correctly mapped to ga4_property_id for GA4 data retrieval.
The runReport method is successfully called with metrics=activeUsers and dimensions=deviceCategory.
A dbt model, rpt_sites_engagement, is successfully built from GA4 data.
The Sites API is extended to join data from rpt_sites_management, rpt_sites_usage_trends, and rpt_sites_engagement.
Clients can call a single endpoint to retrieve combined data covering inventory, security posture, adoption metrics, and device-level engagement.

tasks.title: Project Kick-off & Requirements Deep Dive
tasks.description: Conduct initial project meeting with PM, Dev, Architect, QA to review the brief, clarify scope, define success metrics, and establish communication protocols. Finalize detailed functional and non-functional requirements.

tasks.title: Architectural Design & Data Modeling
tasks.description: Design the overall architecture for data ingestion, BigQuery schema (staging, raw, reporting tables: rpt_sites_management, rpt_sites_usage_trends, rpt_sites_engagement), dbt models, and API endpoints. Define data flow, error handling, and security considerations.

tasks.title: Implement Admin SDK Reports Activity API Integration
tasks.description: Develop the service/module responsible for connecting to the Admin SDK Reports Activity API (applicationName=drive) to extract doc_title, visibility, and internal/external visibility counts for Google Sites. Implement authentication and error handling.

tasks.title: Develop BigQuery Ingestion for Sites Management Data
tasks.description: Create a daily scheduled job to ingest the extracted Sites management events into the BigQuery staging table, keyed by site_id and data_date. Ensure data quality and idempotency.

tasks.title: Create rpt_sites_management dbt Model
tasks.description: Develop the dbt model rpt_sites_management to transform and aggregate the raw management data into a clean, queryable format, including derived metrics like internal/external visibility counts.

tasks.title: Develop /v1/reports/sites-management Endpoint
tasks.description: Implement the REST API endpoint /v1/reports/sites-management that queries rpt_sites_management. Ensure it supports filtering by date ranges, visibility, and owner, and returns inventories of external sites, internal-only sites, and per-site sharing posture.

tasks.title: Implement Admin SDK Customer Usage Reports Integration
tasks.description: Develop the service/module to connect to the Admin SDK customer usage reports API, specifically consuming sites:num_30day_active_users, sites:num_sites_created, and sites:num_sites_viewed.

tasks.title: Develop BigQuery Ingestion for Sites Usage Data
tasks.description: Create a daily scheduled job to ingest the extracted Sites usage data into a BigQuery raw table, keyed by entity_customer_id and data_date. Align with existing ingestion patterns for Gmail/Drive.

tasks.title: Create rpt_sites_usage_trends dbt Model
tasks.description: Develop the dbt model rpt_sites_usage_trends to process raw usage data, aligning its schema with existing Gmail/Drive usage reports, to surface 30-day active site users, sites created per day, and sites viewed per day.

tasks.title: Implement GA4 Data API Integration (Optional)
tasks.description: Develop the integration for the GA4 Data API. This includes mechanisms for customers to link GA4 properties to Sites, mapping site_id to ga4_property_id, and calling runReport with metrics=activeUsers and dimensions=deviceCategory.

tasks.title: Develop BigQuery Ingestion & rpt_sites_engagement dbt Model
tasks.description: Create the ingestion pipeline for GA4 data into BigQuery and develop the dbt model rpt_sites_engagement to structure and report on device-level engagement data.

tasks.title: Develop Unified Sites Analytics API Endpoint
tasks.description: Implement the final API endpoint that orchestrates queries across rpt_sites_management, rpt_sites_usage_trends, and rpt_sites_engagement. This endpoint should provide a comprehensive view of inventory, security posture, adoption metrics, and device-level engagement.

tasks.title: API Documentation & SDK Updates
tasks.description: Document the new API endpoints, request/response schemas, and filtering options. Update any relevant SDKs or client libraries to support the new Sites Analytics features.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing & QA
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit, integration, system, and performance testing for all data pipelines, dbt models, and API endpoints. Verify data accuracy, completeness, security, and API response times.

tasks.title: Deployment & Monitoring Setup
tasks.description: Deploy the new services, dbt models, and API endpoints to production. Set up robust monitoring, alerting, and logging for data ingestion jobs, BigQuery pipelines, and API performance.
